raw_response:
I’m farming only 6 mu, so I can’t take big risks. What I do is mostly what has worked on my land and what the neighbors do. Wheat is already in the field now, so for this crop I mainly need to watch water and topdressing. If the wheat stays green and the rain is not too bad, I won’t push too hard, because fertilizer and pumping water both cost money, and our family also needs cash for daily life. After wheat harvest, I will plant maize right away. In our place the wheat-maize turn is very tight, so I won’t do fancy tillage, just simple field cleaning and quick sowing. For maize I will still use hybrid seed like most people here, put a base fertilizer, then one topdress if the crop looks good. I’d rather spend a little on fertilizer than let the crop go hungry, but I also won’t go too heavy because 6 mu is small and I have to keep some cash in hand.
